title: Deep-learning CADe colonoscopy raises adenoma detection in a double-blind trial
summary: In a double-blind randomised trial of 962 patients in China (484 analysed with CADe, 478 with a sham system), the deep-learning system raised adenoma detection to 34% (165/484) from 28% (132/478), OR 1.36 (95% CI 1.03-1.79). The primary analysis was per protocol, the trial was single-centre, and the abstract reports no ITT analysis.
ai_technology: Deep-learning computer-aided detection (CADe) system for polyps during colonoscopy
organization: Sichuan Academy of Medical Sciences and Sichuan Provincial People's Hospital; Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
